question: 은행 안내엔 송금 통화가 태국 바트라고 되어 있고 머니그램 쪽은 보낼 때 미화로 처리될 수 있다고 해서, 제가 등록하면 수취인이 현지에서 다른 통화로 돈을 받게 되는지 잘 모르겠어요

nuggets.value: A transfer made to a country outside of Korea shall be made in United States Dollars (USD)
Service Rep. will convert any other currency to USD at the time of sending
the Service Rep may charge an exchange and/or an administrative fee
exchange rate established by MoneyGram or its Service Reps at the time funds are disbursed to the receiver
Service Reps within a country may not apply a uniform currency exchange rate
